# AGENTS.md — Conventions for AI assistants

Single source of truth for project conventions. Included for Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and other agents. Do not duplicate these rules elsewhere.

**Do not edit this file unless the user asks.**

## Coding conventions

- **DRY**: extract a shared helper when two methods diverge only at the edges (5+ duplicated lines → refactor).
- **Idiomatic stdlib first**: `System.Uri`, `IPEndPoint`, `Path.Combine`, etc. Hand-rolled parsers need a one-line justification.
- **Readable parsing**: read CLI args and env vars at the destination field; no name-translation tables.
- **No redundant naming**: enum members must not repeat the enum name (`HandshakeState.Awaiting`, not `AwaitingHandshake`).
- **Monotonic time**: `Godot.Time.GetTicksMsec()` (cast to `long` when storing) for sync and latency — not wall-clock Unix time.
- **No backwards-compat scaffolding** pre-1.0: rename by deleting the old symbol and fixing callers.
- **Nullable reference types**: project-wide `<Nullable>enable</Nullable>`; nullable warnings are errors. Scene/`[Export]` fields set in `_Ready`: `= null!`. Optional refs: `T?`. Prefer `is T` over `as T` when the type is expected.
- **No emojis** in code, commits, file names, or assistant responses unless asked.
- **Comments**: explain *why* or non-obvious intent — not what the code obviously does. Preserve useful comments when refactoring.
- **Method order** (per class/file): `_Ready`, `_ExitTree`, `_Process`, `_PhysicsProcess` (omit any not used), then all `[Rpc]` methods grouped together, then private methods, then public methods. When adding or moving methods, preserve this order.

## Reference docs

- **C# guide:** [`docs/csharp-guide-for-ts-devs.md`](docs/csharp-guide-for-ts-devs.md) — engine-neutral C# for TS/systems devs. Not Godot policy.

## Tooling

- **Dev commands:** [`README.md`](README.md) — `dotnet`, `docker`, `godot` directly; no Makefile.
- **Format:** csharpier 0.30.6 — `dotnet tool restore` then `dotnet csharpier .`
- **Build:** `dotnet build starter-template.csproj` — no new warnings.
